newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares up for seventh day on high volume.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares up for seventh day on high volume.

text.p: Slovenia's SBI share index continued its upward trek for the seventh consecutive trading session on Wednesday, but traders were mixed on the outlook for the future.
"The trend has been upward in the past two weeks with some corrections. It is hard to say how long this optimism will last but profit taking is likely to lower prices," one broker said.
* The SBI index rose 0.47 percent or 6.85 points to 1,476.70.
* Drug maker Lek was the most active, firming 0.29 percent to 35,000 tolars on volume of 254.5 million tolars.
* Brokerage Dadas was the top gainer, jumping 8.88 percent to 6,500 tolars on volume of only one share. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
